scope: Proteomic analysis of serum, sample preparation, and analysis
Serum samples underwent depletion of highly abundant protein using High Select™ Top14 Abundant Protein Depletion Mini Spin Columns (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
The depleted serum samples were used for filter-aided sample preparation (FASP, 30 kDa cut-off cartridges) as described elsewhere using 0.5 μg of trypsin (sequencing grade; Promega).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics was performed on serum. While the serum underwent depletion of the top 14 abundant proteins, this is a standard sample cleanup/fractionation step for serum proteomics and does not constitute affinity purification of a specific protein complex or an organelle-enriched fraction. Per the mapping rules, unfractionated (or depleted) bulk material like serum is categorized under whole cell lysate (bulk proteome) scope.
